description.short_caption: Abdominal distension with visible striae and discoloration.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows a patient with significant abdominal distension. The skin over the abdomen displays prominent striae, which are linear marks suggestive of stretching. There is also some discoloration visible on the abdominal surface. The patient’s shirt is lifted to expose the abdomen, and the image is taken in a clinical setting.
